messages:
Alex: Confession time  spilled an iced latte ONTO my router while trying to balance a laptop on my knees during a 2pm demo. panic mode. photo: https://imgur.com/icedrouter.jpg :cry:
Noor: oh nooooo 62c did it survive?
Alex: Blinkers went full disco for a minute then died. Ran to the kitchen, dried it with towels and a hairdryer (low heat). rebooted once, amber light then nothing. RIP?
Ben: RIP router. Next one: put it in a cereal box. Kidding. But do let it dry 48 hours in rice or silica. Also: async offer to lend my travel router if you need one for the rest of the week.
Pat: Also check your ethernet ports on the laptop. Liquid + ports = surprises.
Alex: Laptop fine, keyboard sticky but alive. Router smelled faintly of espresso. :coffee: Ordered a replacement with same-day delivery.
Noor: Two small tips: 1) quick temporary fix = tether to phone, but enable "Limit High Data" on Zoom. 2) if you use hotspot, mute video; phone battery dies fast otherwise.
RouterBot: ISP alert: detected outage at 14:07-14:25 for Alex's home subnet. Auto-fallback not configured.
Ben: We should create a "WFH survival kit" wiki: spare router, silicone keyboard cover, USB-C tether, mini surge protector, cable ties. Anyone wanna start a Google Doc?
Pat: I'll seed the doc. Voting: should we make "WFH Fails Friday" a recurring topic in #random? :laughing:
Noor: absolutely yes. I will contribute my 2023 story (dog + sandwich + laptop).
Alex: Thank you all for the tips and offers. Learned two things today: no caffeine near electronics, and apparently my cat approves of my new router-less aesthetic. :cat:
